newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Grancare Inc cut to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Grancare Inc cut to buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Mark Banta said he downgraded Grancare Inc to "buy" from "strong buy," in view of its stock run up following word of the definitive merger agrement of its TeamCare pharmacy subsidiary with Vitalink Pharmacy Services Inc.

-- "We view this merger very positively for both GranCare and Vitaline shareholders," Banta said in a report. "However, GranCare shares are now approaching our revised asset and cash flow valuations."
